recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the approved clarification across the active paired resource pages without changing conformance structures or adding broader vaccine/medication policy.
issue_request: FHIR-32960 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to clarify inconsistent MedicationAdministration vaccine wording: Scope and Usage had said all medications and vaccines, while Boundaries said non-vaccine medications. The approved resolution removed those contradictory phrases, directed readers to Immunization for vaccines, and allowed MedicationAdministration for vaccination workflow reasons if systems also create and expose an equivalent Immunization instance.
initial_application: Git commit 6cdd7b792e2241b7191584bd35915d4b0f9841f8 explicitly mentioned FHIR-32960 and applied most of the change to source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-introduction.xml. It did not update the active source/immunization/immunization-introduction.xml boundary paragraph, which still said MedicationAdministration was for non-vaccine medications, and it left minor MedicationAdministration-page remnants of the old resource/Profile and spaced resource-name wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists both immunization=Immunization and medicationadministration=MedicationAdministration as active resources. Pharmacy minutes on 2021-07-19 record the FHIR-32960 consistency issue, note the workflow-purpose MedicationAdministration exception, and document a 6-0-0 motion to accept. Searches found older background issues FHIR-7731 and FHIR-7732 but no later Jira, Zulip, or Confluence decision reversing FHIR-32960.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-introduction.xml to remove resource/Profile and normalize the MedicationAdministration resource name. Changed source/immunization/immunization-introduction.xml to remove the stale non-vaccine medications statement and mirror the FHIR-32960 allowance plus equivalent Immunization requirement.
